summary: Brazil plunged deeper into diplomatic disputes with two of its most important partners in the Americas over what it described as attempts by the conservative governments of the US and Argentina to interfere in its October presidential election.

title: Progressive Michigan Win Makes General Election Challenging, Morgan Stanley’s Salvatore Says

summary: Ariana Salvatore, head of US public policy strategy at Morgan Stanley, says a win by progressive Abdul El-Sayed in the Democratic US Senate primary in Michigan “makes it really challenging as a general election seat for Democrats to flip,” and looks at how the US economy plays into the midterm elections. title: Trump Takes Economic Message to Vegas as Midterm Campaigns Heat Up

summary: Both parties are feeling the pressure entering the final 13 weeks of campaigning.

title: Russian Barrage Kills 17 as Ukraine Fails to Stop Missiles
